samples.summary: The new `workflow_run.path == '.github/workflows/ci.yml'` guard is pinned by a test only in agent-review-panel.yml; the same guard in agent-iterate-ci.yml and ci-report.yml is untested
samples.evidence: checks.test.mjs (lines 175–218) substitutes `github.event.workflow_run.path` into the panel's gate `if:` and its concurrency suffix and asserts both refuse `.github/workflows/pwn.yml` and admit `CI_WORKFLOW_PATH` — so the panel's literal is genuinely pinned to the exported constant. No equivalent assertion exists for the two other gates this diff hardens: a repo-wide grep for `workflow_run.path` finds only the three workflow files plus checks.test.mjs/mark-ready.test.mjs (which reference the panel and the JS helper), and scripts/test/ci-workflow.test.mjs never inspects the report job's `if:` (its job-level `if:` scans are about matrix/skip-marker concerns, lines 42–104, 257–273, 410–416). loop-status.test.mjs touches agent-iterate-ci.yml only for the paged-latch literal. Consequence: deleting or misspelling the path clause in agent-iterate-ci.yml (whose fixer job holds `contents: write` and pushes to the PR branch) or in ci-report.yml (which writes PR comments with an App token) would break no test — precisely the guard the diff and its comments say is load-bearing, and precisely the property the panel test bothers to prove. Also note docs/design/harness-engineering.md:1938 asserts these workflows 'therefore assert `github.event.workflow_run.path` in their gating job' with no test backing that claim for two of the three.
searchedFor: grep for iterate-ci / ci-report / head_repository in scripts/**/*.test.mjs

samples.summary: set-state's switch from name-based to path-based CI matching in gatherSignals has no test at all
samples.evidence: `gatherSignals` is module-private (set-state.mjs:211) and set-state.test.mjs contains no CLI/stub-level test — grep for `GH_STUB|spawnSync|workflowRuns` in scripts/agent/set-state.test.mjs returns nothing; its CI coverage is only `deriveState({ ciConclusion: ... })` (lines 83–99), i.e. the derived signal is injected, never produced. So the new `ciConclusion(runs)` wiring (wrong field, wrong response shape, forgotten `.workflow_runs`) would be caught by nothing; only the pure helper is covered in checks.test.mjs. Impact is contained (wrong lifecycle label / state comment rather than a promotion), hence minor.

samples.summary: The gate→loop-status `outcome` contract test checks the vocabulary on both sides but not the `OUTCOME:` env binding that carries it
samples.evidence: The new test extracts `outcome=<name>` writes from the gate step's window and the `case "$OUTCOME" in` labels from the loop-status step and asserts the two sets agree (mark-ready.test.mjs, 'the `outcome` vocabulary is a contract BETWEEN TWO STEPS' block). It never asserts the plumbing: `OUTCOME: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.outcome }}` (agent-review-panel.yml:1563). Drop or rename that env line and `$OUTCOME` is empty for every run, so every non-promotion falls into the `*)` note — 'cancelled, killed, or never ran' — which is exactly the mis-attribution the outcome output was added to remove, and the vocabulary test still passes. Observability-only, so minor.
searchedFor: read new assertions in scripts/agent/mark-ready.test.mjs ('agent-review-panel.yml handles every mark-ready code')
grep OUTCOME in the panel workflow

samples.summary: The `set +e` / `cat … || true` framing the diff's comments call load-bearing is not asserted anywhere
samples.evidence: The workflow-text test asserts only the redirect (`> "$RUNNER_TEMP/mark-ready.log" 2>&1`), the absence of a pipe before `code=$?`, and the `case` branch shapes. Nothing pins `set +e` around the invocation (without it, `set -e` kills the step before `code=$?`, so no outcome is recorded) or the `|| true` on the `cat` (whose removal the diff's own comment says would misreport a tooling failure as 'cancelled, killed, or never ran'). Both are one-line deletions with no test failure; the whole block is only ever asserted as text, never executed, so this is a small extension of the existing textual pattern rather than a new class of gap.
searchedFor: read the 'agent-review-panel.yml handles every mark-ready code' test body

verdict.reason: The path guard is genuinely pinned by a test only for agent-review-panel.yml. scripts/agent/checks.test.mjs:130 hard-codes the panel file, substitutes github.event.workflow_run.path -> PATH (line 181) and asserts refusal of '.github/workflows/pwn.yml' in both the gate `if:` and the concurrency suffix (lines 193-218). A repo-wide grep for `workflow_run\.path` outside .trusted/ matches only the three workflow files, docs, and .agent-review prose — no test file contains the token at all. Grepping `workflow_run` across every scripts/**/*.test.mjs finds no other gate-expression evaluation: agent-workflow-guards.test.mjs (read in full) only matches `ref:` head_branch/head_sha for checkout-order guards; ci-workflow.test.mjs's `if:` handling covers matrix gating, the gate-marker step and the App-token pr_number gate, never the report job's job-level `if:` at ci-report.yml:54-56; loop-status.test.mjs:327-364 only does wf.includes on latch/author literals in agent-iterate-ci.yml. I also widened beyond the reviewer's searches (Glob scripts/test/** — 9 files, all grepped; grep for ci-report.yml|agent-iterate-ci.yml across scripts/**/*.mjs; grep for workflow_run outside scripts/, docs/, .trusted/, .agent-review/, .github/workflows/) and found no other test location. Consequence: removing the path clause at agent-iterate-ci.yml:54 (fixer arm holds contents: write and pushes to the PR branch) or ci-report.yml:56 (App-token PR comments) breaks no test, i.e. a security guard the diff's own comments call load-bearing can be silently weakened — major under this lens's "silently weaken a guard" criterion.
